## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta7

### Release infrastructure
- Make `npm test` read-only so validation can no longer modify tracked runtime or changelog files.
- Replace beta-specific version scripts with one generic runtime-version synchronizer.
- Replace beta-specific/duplicate publishers with one version-agnostic release workflow for prereleases and stable releases.
- Add a generic release-PR preparation workflow that synchronizes the runtime version and committed `dist` copy before final validation.
- Make active regression tests feature-based instead of hard-coding the current beta number.
- Keep the existing Map Card runtime and beta6 UI behavior unchanged apart from the beta7 version marker.
